'''Enbo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Calimondretta]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Syned]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]], working as an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Arkadia Calimondra]].<ref name="Knight Errant novel">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref>
